description: BOSZ 2024 release tree at MAST (HLSP), verified live 2026-10-17 (bulk-download surface 2026-10-18). The upstream publishing unit is one (broadening, metallicity) directory; its official bulk package is the per-directory bulkdl.sh script — a plain list of per-file curl commands covering every spectrum file of that directory. stellarlib mirrors whole directories: one product = one (broadening, metallicity) directory as enumerated by its official bulkdl script, plus one shared product for the wavelength_grids directory. The blueprint declares all 112 directory mirrors.

verified.note_original_sampling: rorig/ holds the original-sampling variant (noresam files, own wavelength column)

bulk_download_surface.verified: 2026-10-18: 112 scripts listed under download_scripts/, one per (broadening, metallicity); no directory-level tarballs exist (probes 404)
bulk_download_surface.files_per_script: 45724 spectrum files each (resam for r500..r50000, noresam for rorig; counted on r500, r10000, rorig at m+0.00)
bulk_download_surface.lineid_exclusion: rorig directories additionally hold 11431 lineid files (line identifications, v0 only) that the official bulkdl scripts do not include — a separate upstream product line, outside the spectra mirror

sample_file_sizes_bytes_per_resolution.note: one HEAD sample per resolution at m+0.00 (gz size varies with model); order-of-magnitude scale, not an inventory

format_notes: resam files are two-column gzip ASCII (Eddington flux H_lambda, continuum) with no wavelength column; rows align by index with the per-resolution wavelength grid file
rorig noresam files carry their own wavelength column (three columns)
wavelength grids are log-uniform; r500 spans 500 Angstrom to 31.97 micron in 7500 points, r10000 in 150000 points
upstream clips H_lambda below 1e-6 erg/s/cm^2/Angstrom to zero (continuum to 1); no checksums are published
references: Meszaros, S., et al. 2024, A&A, 688, A197
Bohlin, G., et al. 2017, AJ, 154, 106 (legacy library)
